name: web-next-vercel
summary: Next.js app on Vercel with a Postgres database (Neon), pnpm, Vitest.
skill_rows: | `/security-pass [url]` | dependency audit, secret scan, bundle leak, headers, then the security reviewer | a verdict |
| `/deploy-web` | runbook for CI, preview and production deploys (push to main = deploy) | confirmation the deploy landed |
after_steps: run pnpm lint and report its result
run pnpm typecheck and report its result
run pnpm test and report its result
run pnpm build and report its result
make one commit of the working tree in the repository's whole-sentence style
git push to the upstream branch; a push to main deploys
one_time_steps: Vercel: set VERCEL_TOKEN, VERCEL_ORG_ID, VERCEL_PROJECT_ID as GitHub repo secrets; set the app's env vars in the Vercel project for Production AND Preview.
Neon: set NEON_API_KEY as a repo secret and NEON_PROJECT_ID as a repo variable; set DATABASE_URL as a repo secret for the production migrate step.
Mirror every required env-schema field into the placeholder block of .github/workflows/ci.yml.
